answer: A fresh alias is therefore worth nothing for 15 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. Farming becomes a falcon bet on surviving 103 epochs of grading, and every ferrous settlement recomputes the ocean schedule, so someone who quits early keeps almost nothing. New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 103 epochs rather than arriving at once. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
